comparison.objective: Crack and open an egg over a bowl, separate contents and dispose of shell halves; candidate tunes a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual grasp, impact initiation, shell separation and material sorting versus precision tool insertion, collar rotation, locking and dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: Requires a qualifying rim impact, ≥8 mm shell separation, yolk/white in bowl and shells in tray; candidate requires controlled carriage impacts without hard-stop contact or excessive rebound.
comparison.reason: Although both include impacts, one tests fracture/opening and sorting while the candidate tests energy-dissipation adjustment.
